items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: I was trying while talking to think of a fellow named, uh, Ed Jones, I think. He used to lead his band.

ctx.x: How did those bands compare with the New Orleans bands when you heard them later? That is, the brass band, did they swing a good deal, you know? I mean, on the street, like the funerals, you talk about coming back, you know, where they'd really swing now. Yeah, yeah. Did the Mobile bands play that same style?

They picked that up and got that out, yeah, after, like I say, the King and Christian, they kind of give them a few lessons in it, what it was all about. I was trying while talking to think of a fellow named, uh, Ed Jones, I think. He used to lead his band. He was the original, the leader of the original Eureka band, Ed Jones. In Mobile? In Mobile. And he...
Was that Eureka or Excelsior, do you remember?
